title: 第 53 章 以后你们别找他的麻烦了第 52 章 看来此事已经闹到宗主那边了
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 大长老回到外门住处的时候天色已经暗了下来，他推开门走进屋里脸上带着几分疲惫和阴沉的神色。
而陆云和陆瑶兄妹俩早就等在这里了，看到大长老进来之后两人立刻站起身来迎了上去。
“师父怎么样了。”陆云迫不及待的问道。
“宗主那边怎么说，是不是已经定了陈默的罪了。”
这时大长老看了他们一眼然后在椅子上坐下来，他端起茶杯喝了一口然后重重的放下。
“沈清璇在通天峰跟老夫吵起来了。”大长老说道。
“吵得非常激烈，连宗主都劝不住。”
当陆云和陆瑶听到这话之后都愣住了，他们对视一眼然后脸上露出了不敢相信的表情。
“师父您说什么。”陆云说道。
“沈长老跟您吵起来了，她那样冷若冰霜的一个人居然会为了陈默跟您吵架。”
“我也没想到。”大长老说道。
“老夫去通天峰之前以为沈清璇最多就是替陈默辩解几句，没想到她直接拍了桌子。”
“当着宗主的面跟老夫吵了大半个时辰，说什么陈默是被诬陷的，说老夫的两个弟子先动的手。”
这时陆瑶的脸色变得极其难看，她的手攥着衣角眼中全是不甘和怨恨。
“沈长老怎么能这样，她分明是在包庇陈默那个混蛋。”
“那个陈默明明给我们下了毒，她凭什么说我们是诬陷。”
“闭嘴。”大长老冷声道。
“你以为老夫不想替你们讨回公道吗，老夫在通天峰已经尽力了。”
“可沈清璇那个女人的态度太强硬了，宗主最后也没表态只是说容后再议。”
听到这话陆云咬了咬牙心中满是不甘，他在心里想着费了这么大功夫结果还是没有把陈默怎么样。
“师父那这件事就这么算了吗。”陆云说道。
“弟子和妹妹的修为都跌了这么多，难道就这么放过陈默了。”
而大长老沉默了片刻以后抬起头看着他们，他的眼神中带着几分复杂的情绪。
“老夫回来的时候想了一路。”大长老说道。
“有一件事老夫必须提醒你们。”
“什么事。”陆云问道。
“你们最好不要再招惹陈默了。”大长老说道。
这时陆云和陆瑶都愣住了他们以为自己听错了，两人瞪大眼睛看着大长老。
“师父您说什么。”陆瑶说道。
“您让我们不要再招惹陈默，他可是把我们害成这样的凶手啊。”
“老夫知道你们不甘心。”大长老说道。
“但老夫怀疑那个陈默比我们想象中要强得多，而且他的底牌可能不止我们看到的那一点。”
只见陆云听到这句话之后脸色变了一下，他在心里想着师父怎么突然这么说。
“师父您为什么这么说。”陆云问道。
“今天在通天峰的时候老夫听到一个小道消息。”大长老说道。
“有人说沈清璇之所以能突破瓶颈踏入破妄期大圆满，是因为得到了一枚灵品丹药。”
“而据说那枚灵品丹药就是陈默给她的。”
当陆云和陆瑶听到这句话之后整个人都傻了，他们的嘴巴张得大大的半天说不出一个字来。
灵品丹药，陈默居然能拿出灵品丹药。
“师父您说的不是真的吧。”陆云的声音都有些颤抖了起来。
“陈默他一个外门弟子怎么可能有灵品丹药，那东西在内门都没几个人有。”
“老夫也希望是假的。”大长老说道。
content_en:
It was already dark when the great elder returned to his outer residence. He opened the door and walked into the house with a tired and gloomy look on his face.
The brothers Lu Yun and Lu Yao had been waiting here for a long time. When they saw the great elder coming in, they immediately stood up and greeted him.
"How is Master?" Lu Yun asked impatiently.
"What does the sect leader say? Has Chen Mo been convicted?"
At this time, the great elder glanced at them and sat down on the chair. He picked up the tea cup and took a sip before putting it down heavily.
"Shen Qingxuan had a quarrel with me at Tongtian Peak," the elder said.
"The quarrel was so fierce that even the sect leader couldn't stop it."
When Lu Yun and Lu Yao heard this, they were both stunned. They looked at each other with expressions of disbelief on their faces.
"Master, what did you say?" Lu Yun said.
"Elder Shen has had a quarrel with you. A person as cold as hers would actually quarrel with you over Chen Mo."
"I didn't expect it either," the great elder said.
"Before I went to Tongtian Peak, I thought that Shen Qingxuan would just defend Chen Mo a few words, but I didn't expect that she would just slap the table."
"I argued with me for more than half an hour in front of the sect leader, saying that Chen Mo was framed and that my two disciples made the move first."
At this time, Lu Yao's face became extremely ugly. Her hands were holding the corners of her clothes, and her eyes were full of unwillingness and resentment.
"How could Elder Shen do this? She is clearly protecting that bastard Chen Mo."
"That Chen Mo clearly poisoned us, why did she say we were framed."
"Shut up." The great elder said coldly.
"Do you think I don't want to seek justice for you? I have already tried my best at Tongtian Peak."
"But that woman Shen Qingxuan's attitude was too tough. The sect master didn't express his position in the end and just said that we would discuss it later."
Hearing this, Lu Yun gritted his teeth and felt unwilling to do anything. He thought in his heart that after so much effort, nothing happened to Chen Mo.
"Master, let's just forget about this matter," Lu Yun said.
"My disciple and my sister's cultivation has dropped so much. How can we just let Chen Mo go?"
After the great elder was silent for a moment, he raised his head and looked at them, with somewhat complicated emotions in his eyes.
"I thought about it when I came back," the great elder said.
"There is one thing I must remind you."
"What's the matter?" Lu Yun asked.
"You'd better not provoke Chen Mo again." The great elder said.
At this time, Lu Yun and Lu Yao were both stunned. They thought they had heard wrongly. They looked at the great elder with wide eyes.
"Master, what did you say?" Lu Yao said.
"Please tell us not to provoke Chen Mo again, he has made us such a murderer."
"I know you are not willing to give in," the great elder said.
"But I suspect that Chen Mo is much stronger than we thought, and his trump card may be more than what we see."
Lu Yun's face changed slightly after hearing these words. He was thinking in his mind why the master suddenly said this.
"Master, why do you say that?" Lu Yun asked.
"I heard a rumor today when I was at Tongtian Peak." The great elder said.
"Some people say that the reason why Shen Qingxuan was able to break through the bottleneck and enter the stage of breaking the delusion was because he got a spiritual elixir."
"And it is said that the spiritual elixir was given to her by Chen Mo."
When Lu Yun and Lu Yao heard this sentence, they were stunned. Their mouths were wide open and they couldn't say a word for a long time.
Chen Mo was actually able to come up with a spiritual elixir.
"Master, what you said is not true." Lu Yun's voice trembled a little.
"How can Chen Mo, an outer sect disciple, have spiritual elixirs? Not many people in the inner sect have those things."
"I also hope it's fake." The great elder said.
title_en: Chapter 53 Don’t cause trouble with him in the future. Chapter 52 It seems that this matter has already been brought to the Sect Leader’s side.
